guidance_fy26.status: UNVERIFIED - not on EDGAR. Visa gives its outlook only on the earnings call / webcast slides (investor.visa.com, blocked); since FY2020 the 8-K Item 2.02 Ex. 99.1 release contains no outlook. Figures below are from secondary summaries of the Q3 FY26 call (28-Jul-2026) found by web search; the sources disagree in places.
guidance_fy26.q4_net_revenue_note: Q4 FY26 adjusted net revenue growth 'similar to Q3' (Q3: +14% nominal, +13% constant dollar) - UNVERIFIED. Model end-points high / mid / low = 14% / 13% / 12% on Q4 FY25 net revenue $10,724m.
guidance_fy26.q4_adj_eps_note: Q4 FY26 non-GAAP EPS growth 'low end of mid-teens' - UNVERIFIED. End-points 15% / 14% / 13% on Q4 FY25 non-GAAP EPS $2.98.
guidance_fy26.q4_opex_growth_note: Q4 FY26 adjusted operating expense growth 'low double digits' - UNVERIFIED (information row).
guidance_fy26.fy_eps_growth_note: Full-year FY26 non-GAAP EPS growth 'low end of mid-teens' (raised) - UNVERIFIED (information row).
guidance_fy26.fy_rev_note: Some summaries cite full-year FY26 net revenue growth 'low end of low-teens'; with 9M FY26 net revenue +15.3% that would imply Q4 growth of ~3%, which conflicts with the Q4 commentary - not used (information only).
guidance_fy26.fy_nonop_note: FY26 non-GAAP non-operating expense ~$165m and tax rate 18.0-18.25% (call; UNVERIFIED). 9M FY26 non-GAAP non-operating expense $84m -> Q4 ~$81m.

q4_inputs.pv_growth_note: Q3 FY26 release (8-K 28-Jul-2026, Ex. 99.1) 'Key business drivers': payments volume growth for the quarter ended 30-Jun-2026 +11% nominal (+10% constant). Service revenue in Q4 FY26 is based on this quarter's volume (company: service revenue is assessed on prior-quarter payments volume).
q4_inputs.dividend_note: Q3 FY26 release: on 28-Jul-2026 the board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.670 per class A share (paid 1-Sep-2026).

buyback.note: Q3 FY26 10-Q Part II Item 2: remaining authorization $28,352m at 30-Jun-2026 (incl. the $20.0bn program authorized Apr-2026). Q3 FY26: 14 million shares at $330.71 average; 9M FY26 $16.5bn (50 million shares).

shares.note: Proxy for as-converted class A shares at 30-Jun-2026: Q3 FY26 weighted diluted class A shares (1,898m, as-converted incl. class B / C common and series A / B / C preferred) less half of the 14.5m shares repurchased in the quarter. Visa reports no single as-converted period-end count in the release (ONON precedent: weighted count as period-end proxy).

debt.at_2026_06_30: Q3 FY26 10-Q Note 6: total debt $24,131m principal (carrying $23,858m: current maturities $2,996m, long-term $20,862m) incl. commercial paper $1,500m (3.77%). USD senior notes 0.75-4.70%; EUR notes 2.00-3.875%.
debt.new_notes_note: Feb-2026: $3.0bn fixed-rate notes (3.80% 2029, 4.10% 2031, 4.40% 2033, 4.70% 2036). Maturities assumed refinanced with new notes at ~4.5% (assumption).

amort.note: FY2025 10-K Notes 7-8: estimated amortization of finite-lived intangibles (customer relationships) $63m / $62m / $43m / $29m / $10m (FY26-30) and of technology (capitalized software and acquired technology, inside D&A) $802m / $640m / $509m / $355m / $174m. The non-GAAP item 'amortization of acquired intangible assets' ($232m FY25; $168m 9M FY26) covers acquired technology + customer relationships. Forecast item: $64m Q4/26E (Q3 run-rate), then $230m / $190m / $150m / $110m / $80m FY27-31 (assumption, declining with the 10-K schedules) + future-acquisition amortization.

litigation.note: U.S. retrospective responsibility plan: covered litigation is paid from the U.S. litigation escrow ($888m at 30-Jun-2026; $875m deposited 9M FY26), funded by reducing the class B conversion rate (an as-converted share reduction with no P&L effect). VE territory covered losses are recovered through series B / C preferred conversion-rate adjustments. Litigation provisions are excluded from non-GAAP results; the forecast assumes no further provisions or escrow deposits (assumption).

deals.visa_europe: Visa Europe acquired 21-Jun-2016 (Q3 FY2016): up-front cash EUR 12.25bn ($13.9bn), preferred stock (series B / C) ~$5.3bn and deferred cash EUR 1.0bn (paid Jun-2019); Visa Europe framework agreement loss $1,877m (Q3 FY16, non-GAAP item). FY2016 10-K Note 2.
deals.recent: Currencycloud (Dec-2021, FY22), Tink (Mar-2023, FY23), Pismo (Jan-2024, FY24), Featurespace (Dec-2024, FY25); FY26: acquisitions net of cash $705m (9M, cash-flow statement).

price.note: User-provided share price ($389, given 12-Oct-2026). Latest SEC-filed price for reference: $330.82 weighted-average repurchase price, June 2026 (Q3 FY26 10-Q Part II Item 2).
